title: Run Conformance Tests
description: Our view at the pass loop: fleetd schedules the docs_sync job and then the conformance job of 1 agent CLI and its version (A31, A33).

cli.description: The agent CLI, e.g. claude, codex, agy, opencode. An open string: the roster names the CLIs.

version.description: The CLI version that the conformance job checks, as the CLI reports it.
